body.instrument: latticelife.experiments.local (LatticeLife 256450b): each block's local transient, the largest of which is the global transient (checked on every run)
body.tail: t_min = the 99% quantile (rounded down) of the pooled 8 x 8 local transients at 1024; the same t_min at 256. body.title: Do B2/S34's local settling times explain its global spread and slope?
